reasoning: Shows a file folder containing an upward arrow, universally recognized as uploading, exporting, or backing up a folder/files. It fits digital admin, backup, and file-sharing tasks very well, though at a quick glance it must be distinguished from folder-download (down arrow) or parent-directory navigation.

pass1.ambiguity: In file manager UIs an up-arrow in a folder often means 'go to parent folder', whereas in general apps it means 'upload folder/files'.
